steps.name: implement
steps.label: implementation
prompt: Read the relevant code before you change it, implement the task, and run the relevant tests. Change nothing in {{run}}/.
When done, commit the change as one commit.
again: Fix them one by one; where you disagree, say why. Run the relevant tests, and commit as one commit.

steps.name: review
prompt: Review the change, git diff {{base}} (uncommitted work included): does it do the task? Read only: change no files.
Report only real problems: bugs, missed requirements, clear risks. At most 5, one line each, naming the file and why.
again: The implementer has worked through your last review. Review git diff {{base}} again: are those problems solved, and are there new ones? At most 5.
